claims.statement: As p -> 1+, the trajectory of unique p-Laplacian minimizers converges to the unique weighted entropy minimizer on the compact convex set M_1 of L1 quotient minimizers for finite connected graphs with positive weights.
dependencies: Finite connected graph with positive edge weights.
Gauge-fixed potential subspace F with f(v0) = 0.
Taylor expansion of (1/p)|x|^p around p = 1 and strict convexity of t log t on [0, inf).
claims.limits: Applies to the one-sided limit p -> 1+ on finite connected graphs with positive weights; does not assert thermodynamic dissipation or selection at p = infinity.

claims.statement: For any finite directed graph with integer cochains and positive integer weights, the reduced incidence matrix and augmented LP constraints are totally unimodular, ensuring the existence of an integral optimal potential and integral optimal residual.
dependencies: Finite directed graph topology and root gauge fixing f(v0) = 0.
Poincaré / Hoffman-Kruskal total unimodularity of directed graph incidence matrices.
Extreme-point integrality of totally unimodular polyhedra with integer right-hand side.
claims.limits: Applies to 1-dimensional directed graph complexes with integer data; does not generalize to higher-dimensional cell complexes or non-integral data.

claims.statement: On the triangle 2-simplicial complex, the 4-vertex square plaquette, and the 5-cycle loop complex, the coboundary composite vanishes identically (d1 d0 = 0), ensuring pure gauge connections have zero field curvature and are orthogonal to 1-cycles.
dependencies: Oriented cell complex definitions for triangle, square plaquette, and 5-cycle.
Discrete coboundary operators d0 and d1 as adjoints of boundary operators D1 and D2.
claims.limits: Requires coherent orientation conventions on face boundaries; does not establish continuum Maxwell/Yang-Mills dynamics.

claims.statement: For operator-valued cochains taking values in Schatten-p classes on a finite graph, the quotient defect satisfies non-commutative weak Hölder duality against divergence-free operator circulations, and off-diagonal coherence bounds hold across p in [1, inf].
dependencies: Finite-dimensional Hilbert space H and Schatten-p norm definitions.
Divergence-free circulation constraint d0* Y = 0 on dual operator cochains.
claims.limits: Formulated for finite-dimensional Hilbert spaces and static graph cochains; does not assert continuous Hamiltonian or open-system master equation dynamics.
